#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

using ll = long long;
const int MX = 1000010;
int ans = MX;

vector<ll> ones = {0LL};

void bst(ll x, int vv) {
    if (vv > ans) return;
    if (x == 0) { ans = vv; return; }

    auto lb = lower_bound(ones.begin(), ones.end(), x);
    auto ub = upper_bound(ones.begin(), ones.end(), x);

    if (lb == ub) --lb;

    ll rem = x - *lb;
    int cost = lb - ones.begin();
    ll rem2 = *ub - x;

    bst(x % *lb, vv + cost * (x / *lb));
    bst(rem2, vv + cost + 1);
}

int main() {
    cin.tie(0);
    cin.sync_with_stdio(0);

    ll n;
    cin >> n;

    for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i)
        ones.push_back(ones.back() * 10 + 1);

    bst(n, 0);

    cout << ans << endl;

    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;
const int MX = 1000010;
int ans = MX;
vector<ll> ones = {0LL};

void bst(ll x, int vv) {
    // iterative version using explicit stack
    stack<pair<ll,int>> st;
    st.push({x, vv});
    while (!st.empty()) {
        auto [cx, cv] = st.top(); st.pop();
        if (cv >= ans) continue;
        if (cx == 0) { ans = cv; continue; }

        auto lb = lower_bound(ones.begin(), ones.end(), cx);
        auto ub = upper_bound(ones.begin(), ones.end(), cx);
        if (lb == ub) --lb;
        ll rem = cx - *lb;
        int cost = lb - ones.begin();
        ll rem2 = *ub - cx;

        // second branch first to preserve order (first branch processed first)
        st.push({rem2, cv + cost + 1});
        st.push({cx % *lb, cv + cost * (cx / *lb)});
    }
}

int main() {
    cin.tie(0); cin.sync_with_stdio(0);
    ll n; cin >> n;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i)
        ones.push_back(ones.back() * 10 + 1);
    bst(n, 0);
    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}

using ll = long long;
const int MX = 1000010;
int ans = MX;
array<ll, 17> ones{};

void bst(ll x, int vv) {
    if (vv > ans) return;
    if (x == 0) { ans = vv; return; }

    // manual finding of largest <= x and smallest > x
    ll low = 0, high = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 17; ++i) {
        if (ones[i] <= x) low = ones[i];
        if (ones[i] > x) { high = ones[i]; break; }
    }
    // if high not found (x > all), then low is last, high is last (but then ub = end)
    // we need the same logic as original: find low and high such that low <= x < high, or if x >= last then low = last, high = last.
    if (high == 0) high = low; // x >= last repunit

    ll rem = x - low;
    int cost = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 17; ++i) if (ones[i] == low) { cost = i; break; }
    ll rem2 = high - x;

    bst(x % low, vv + cost * (x / low));
    bst(rem2, vv + cost + 1);
}

int main() {
    cin.tie(0); cin.sync_with_stdio(0);
    ones[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i) ones[i] = ones[i-1] * 10 + 1;
    ll n; cin >> n;

class Solver {
public:

    int ans;
    vector<ll> ones;

    Solver() : ans(MX) {
        ones.push_back(0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i)
            ones.push_back(ones.back() * 10 + 1);
    }

    void bst(ll x, int vv) {
        if (vv >= ans) return;
        if (x == 0) { ans = vv; return; }

        auto lb = lower_bound(ones.begin(), ones.end(), x);
        auto ub = upper_bound(ones.begin(), ones.end(), x);
        if (lb == ub) --lb;

        ll rem = x - *lb;
        int cost = distance(ones.begin(), lb);
        ll rem2 = *ub - x;

        bst(x % *lb, vv + cost * (x / *lb));
        bst(rem2, vv + cost + 1);
    }

    int solve(ll n) {
        bst(n, 0);
        return ans;
    }
};

int main() {
    cin.tie(0); cin.sync_with_stdio(0);
    ll n; cin >> n;
